name: Low Spec!? ~Ore to Toshishita Kanojo to Seikyouiku!~
original_name: Lowすぺっく!?～オレと年下妹（カノジョ）とせいきょーいく！～
source:
Reiji is the acting manager of the Shidou cram school and also acts as the guardian for its students. As their ‘onii-chan’, he looks after his imouto Riina, his best friend’s imouto Miko and close sisters Hane and Sora. However, they grow cuter and more ladylike day by day, unintentionally arousing him to his limit. Will he be able to keep his hands off them or will their innocent temptations be too much to resist?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/11/21/november-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
礼司是志堂补习学校的代理校长，也负责照顾学生。作为她们的“哥哥”，他照料自己的妹妹莉娜、好友的妹妹美子，以及关系亲密的姐妹羽音和空。然而，女孩们一天比一天可爱、成熟，无意间把他的欲望挑逗到极限。他能克制住自己，不对她们出手吗？还是会被她们天真的诱惑彻底击溃？

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/11/21/november-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
